description: Candidate domain screening presets only. No entry establishes applicability, assurance classification, compliance, or certification. Resolve exact standards/editions with a qualified authority for each product and jurisdiction.

profiles.label: Automotive road vehicles
candidate_references: applicable UNECE regulations such as R155/R156 where applicable
required_decisions: hazard/risk classification via applicable vehicle process

profiles.label: Industrial machinery, robotics and collaborative robots
required_decisions: machine boundary and safety-related control functions
guarding, protective stops and human interaction
risk reduction and required performance/integrity determined by applicable process

profiles.label: Process industry, oil and gas, chemical and offshore/onshore facilities
candidate_references: applicable regulator, operator and sector codes
required_decisions: process/system boundary and safety instrumented function allocation
proof test, bypass and override controls

profiles.label: Medical device software and connected medical devices
required_decisions: intended medical purpose and device classification
software safety class and essential performance
quality system, privacy and market authorization

profiles.label: Aviation and airborne systems
candidate_references: DO-254 / ED-80 where hardware is in scope
ARP4754A and ARP4761 family as accepted by the authority
DO-326A / ED-202A where security is in scope
required_decisions: system safety assessment and software/hardware assurance allocation

profiles.label: Railway rolling stock, signalling and infrastructure
Electrical grid, substations and SCADA/OT
candidate_references: IEC 61508/61511 only if a functional safety function is in scope
authority_roles: regulator or reliability organization where applicable
required_decisions: availability, incident response and utility approval

profiles.label: Nuclear facilities and instrumentation/control systems
candidate_references: IEC 60880 and related nuclear I&C standards

profiles.label: Defense and military systems
candidate_references: MIL-STD-882 and program-specific system safety requirements

profiles.label: Consumer, building automation and electrical products with hazardous energy
candidate_references: functional safety standards only when a safety-related control function exists
required_decisions: update support, privacy and customer obligations

profiles.label: Other, mixed or emerging safety-relevant domains
candidate_references: Select applicable sector standards, regulations, customer/operator requirements, and generic functional safety references through formal scope assessment
